source.author: ov
source.text: Dumque ibi quadrupedes caelestia pabula carpunt, noxque vicem peragit, thalamos deus intrat amatos, versus in Eurynomes faciem genetricis, et inter bis sex Leucothoen famulas ad lumina cernit levia versato ducentem stamina fuso.
source.text_original: Dumque ibi quadrupedes caelestia pabula carpunt, / noxque vicem peragit, thalamos deus intrat amatos, / versus in Eurynomes faciem genetricis, et inter / bis sex Leucothoen famulas ad lumina cernit / levia versato ducentem stamina fuso.
source.text_english: And while the four-footed creatures there crop the heavenly pasture, and night completes its turn, the god enters the beloved chamber, changed into the appearance of his mother Eurynome, and among twelve maidservants sees Leucothoë, with the spindle turned, drawing out the delicate threads by the light.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: summie sator, cui nostra dies volventibus annis tot peragit reficitque vices, tuane ista voluntas?
reuse.text_original: 'summie sator, cui nostra dies volventibus annis / tot peragit reficitque vices, tuane ista voluntas?
reuse.text_english: Supreme creator, whose day with the years rolling on carries out and renews so many turns for us, is this your will?
